description: Source code for the wifi_memwraptool module, managing memory wrap configurations, event handling, and bus communication in a WiFi application.

methods.name: push_memwrap_data_dml_to_ctrl_queue
methods.description: Encodes memwrap configuration data and pushes it to the control queue.

methods.name: memwraptool_event_webconfig_set_data
methods.description: Handles webconfig set data event, updating memwrap configuration and executing scripts.

methods.name: handle_memwraptool_webconfig_event
methods.description: Dispatches webconfig events related to memwraptool.

methods.name: memwraptool_monitor_done_event
methods.description: Triggers scripts to monitor memory after configuration changes.

methods.name: handle_memwraptool_command_event
methods.description: Handles command events, such as monitor completion notifications.

methods.name: memwraptool_event
methods.description: Main event handler for memwraptool, dispatching to webconfig or command handlers.

methods.name: memwraptool_get_handler
methods.description: Gets current memwrap configuration parameters via bus.

methods.name: memwraptool_set_handler
methods.description: Sets memwrap configuration parameters via bus, validating input and executing scripts.

methods.name: memwraptool_init
methods.description: Initializes memwraptool application, registers bus data elements.

methods.name: memwraptool_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes memwraptool application, unregisters bus data elements.
